Vipin Kumar And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 30
September, 2024

Author: Raj Beer Singh
Bench: Raj Beer Singh
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:159385
Court No. - 76
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 26755 of 2024
Applicant :- Vipin Kumar And 2 Others
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Lavlesh Kumar Sharma
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Manish Kumar Bhartiya,Mohd. Javed Akhtar
Hon'ble Raj Beer Singh,J.
1.

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Supplementary affidavit filed by learned counsel for the applicants is taken on record.

2. Heard learned counsel for the applicants, learned counsel for the informant and learned A.G.A.
for the State.

3. This application u/s 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed with the prayer to quash the entire proceedings,
including charge-sheet dated 08.06.2024 and cognizance/summoning order dated 24.06.2024, of Case No. 458 of 2024, arising out of case crime no. 18 of 2024, under Sections 498A, 323, 504 IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, P.S.- Bahadurgarh, District- Hapur (Panchsheel Nagar), pending in the Vipin Kumar And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 30 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/194692721/
1 court of Additional Civil Judge (J.D.)/ Judicial Magistrate Ist Class, Garhmukteswar, Hapur.
4.

entities.text: D.P. Act, P.S.- Bahadurgarh, District- Hapur (Panchsheel Nagar
entities.label: STATUTE

entities.text: Vipin Kumar And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 30 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Additional Civil Judge (J.D.)/ Judicial Magistrate Ist Class, Garhmukteswar, Hapur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: After arguing at some length, learned counsel counsel for the applicants submitted that he is not pressing the prayer for quashing of proceedings and instead of that applicants may be permitted to move an application for discharge through counsel before the trial Court concerned and till then protection may be granted to the applicants.
5. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the application.

6. In view of aforesaid, it is directed that in case applicants move an application for discharge through counsel before the trial court concerned within a period of four weeks from today, the same shall be considered and decided expeditiously in accordance with law by the court concerned.

It is further directed that for a period of four weeks from today and in case such an application for discharge is filed within the aforesaid period, till the disposal of discharge application, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicants, provided the applicants cooperate in early disposal of discharge application.
7. The instant application u/s 482 Cr.P.C. is disposed of with aforesaid observations.
